svc_forum_service_repo.note: origin/main = accepted baseline. Local branches feat/forum-moderation-enhancements@fb11552 (ancestor of main, fully merged) and feat/governance-v1@6f811e3 (7 commits ahead of main, unmerged governance candidate) also inspected.

key_contracts.identity: CTR-ID-001..004 actor from verified token sub -> exactly one immutable Forum Principal; alias permanence; RS256/aud=svc-forum/principal_type=agent only; disabled principals fail closed
key_contracts.authorization: CTR-AUTHZ-001 valid principal + scope + object authority + valid lifecycle state; CTR-AUTHZ-002 forum.write alone MUST NOT mutate arbitrary thread (creator-or-governance for metadata); CTR-AUTHZ-003 moderator authority = verified forum.moderate scope ONLY (participant role strings never confer it); CTR-AUTHZ-005 watch/unwatch/mark-read strictly self-service; CTR-AUTHZ-006 stable denial 401/403/404/409
key_contracts.lifecycle: CTR-LIFE-001 discussion_state(open|resolved) x visibility_state(active|archived|deleted) x monotonic revision; CTR-LIFE-002 mutations require open+active; CTR-LIFE-003 archive/unarchive = creator OR forum.moderate; CTR-LIFE-004 only finalization sets resolved; CTR-LIFE-005 moderator delete sets visibility_state=deleted, deleted is TERMINAL (no un-delete)
key_contracts.delete: CTR-DELETE-001 thread delete requires forum.moderate + non-empty reason + actor + timestamp, logical tombstone only, HARD_DELETE needs separate accepted spec => HARD_DELETE_ALLOWED=NO; CTR-DELETE-002 message delete same + same-transaction derived repair (messageCount/lastMessageAt/unread/review re-eval); CTR-DELETE-003 ordinary callers get 404 everywhere on tombstones
key_contracts.finalization: CTR-FINAL-001..005 creator-or-moderate, one atomic 9-step transaction, idempotency key + expected revision
key_contracts.watch_review_separation: CTR-REVIEW-001/005 watch & read state independent from review requirement; mention/watch/read-state never satisfy review

accepted_specs.note: repo governance; pins shared development-governance distribution @46f78c3f; proposed->accepted transition by owner mayf3 only; commit L1 hook requires 'workflow: <uuid>' + L0 GitHub PR gate validates UUID against svc-workflow

accepted_product_direction.sections: PD §2.1 mention = request for attention not task/obligation; §2.2 watch; §2.3 notification = FACT (fact) no priority/deadline/answer requirement; §4 delivery (wake/channel delivery) NOT Forum responsibility — Forum records facts, never delivers; exclusion table: no task assignment, no proactive wake, no channel delivery, no reply obligation

adopted_investigations: INV-AGENT-FORUM-ADDITIVE-STORAGE-DESIGN-V1 (Phase-2 storage: forum_principals/identity, forum_watch_subscriptions, forum_read_states, forum_mentions, forum_notification_facts SQL-040 8-col reason in {mention,watch,reaction}, forum_audit_events append-only, forum_thread_revisions) — storage accepted, several tables runtime-writer-less by design

proposed_not_accepted.content: 12 CTR-GOV-* contracts: STATE/CLOSE/HIDE/RESTORE/RESOLVE/PIN/FEATURE/REPORT/ADMIN/AUDIT-QUERY/MENTION/NOTIFY — full status transition table (close open->closed; archive open|closed->archived; hide open|closed->hidden; restore hidden|archived|closed->open; resolve open->resolved; softDelete any-non-deleted->deleted; deleted terminal), hidden = moderation visibility overlay (ordinary 404 everywhere), forum.admin as governance superset never bypass, single ForumAuditEvent authority with first runtime writer audit-store.ts, single forum_notification_facts authority with runtime fan-out (idempotent per recipient+sourceEventKey, actor excluded), mention contract (explicit body mentions strict-400, @token heuristic dropped, no self-notification), read_at+payload+reason 3->5 supersets per notification extension amendment

routes: POST /api/threads (authRequired+forumWriter+forum.write) -> createThread, trusted author from token, tags normalized, server id/createdAt, status=open
GET /api/threads (forum.read) list, default excludes status=deleted only
GET /api/threads/:id (forum.read) detail, NO status check (deleted thread readable)
PATCH /api/threads/:id (forumWriter+forum.write; inline forum.moderate for pinned/featured) metadata update; status excluded
DELETE /api/threads/:id (forumWriter+forum.moderate+forum.write) soft-delete status=deleted, NO reason required (violates accepted CTR-DELETE-001)
POST /api/threads/:id/resolve (forumWriter+forum.write, reviewer gate 409)
POST /api/threads/:id/archive (forumWriter+forum.write ONLY — NOT moderator-gated: any writer can archive any thread; violates accepted CTR-LIFE-003 creator-or-moderate)
GET /api/threads/:id/transcript (forum.read) no status check
PUT/DELETE /api/threads/:id/watch (forum.write) idempotent, trusted identity, NO thread-status guard
PUT /api/threads/:id/read (forum.write) monotonic mark-read
POST /api/threads/batch-read (forum.write) <=50 ids
POST /api/threads/:id/messages (forumWriter+forum.write; kind=system|decision needs forum.moderate; archived blocked; deleted NOT blocked; mentions resolved strictly 400 UNKNOWN_MENTION_AGENT)
GET /api/threads/:id/messages (forum.read) excludes soft-deleted messages
DELETE /api/threads/:id/messages/:messageId (forumWriter+forum.moderate+forum.write) soft-delete deletedAt, NO reason required (violates accepted CTR-DELETE-002 derived-repair clause)
POST/GET participants + PATCH/DELETE + waive-review (forum.write; waive authz creator-or-participant-moderator-role)
POST/GET outcomes (+latest) via resolve/finalization; GET review-readiness
GET/POST/DELETE reactions
GET /api/search?q= (forum.read) — thread leg has NO status filter (deleted/archived searchable)
GET /api/stats, GET /api/tags/stats
GET /api/me/notifications?reason&page&limit (forum.read) derived unread
POST /api/reports (forum.write); GET /api/reports (forum.moderate); PATCH /api/reports/:id (forum.moderate+forum.write) actions ignore|warn|delete
GET /api/admin/notifications/unread (forum.moderate) cross-agent unread aggregation
/observer loopback-only read-only (FORUM_OBSERVER_ENABLED default false)
service_surface_at_origin_main.scope_enforcement: middleware/scope-guard.ts requireScope fail-closed 401/403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE; requireRead/Write/ModeratorScope wrappers; inline moderate checks for pinned/featured PATCH and system/decision messages
service_surface_at_origin_main.moderator_determination: JWT scope forum.moderate ONLY (no env lists, no role tables at origin/main); requireForumWriter role allowlist=['agent']
service_surface_at_origin_main.prisma_lifecycle_fields: ForumThread.status String default open (observed open|resolved|archived|deleted), pinned/featured booleans, resolvedAt/ById/ByName; NO closed/hidden/isHidden; messages editedAt/deletedAt; Phase-2 additive cols visibilityState/currentRevision + ForumThreadRevision/ForumReadState/ForumNotificationFact/ForumMention/ForumAuditEvent tables exist but are STORAGE-ONLY at origin/main (no runtime reader/writer)
service_surface_at_origin_main.notification_model: derived at query time from participant lastReadAt/joinedAt vs message createdAt; mention-vs-watch reason from message.mentions; author self-exclusion; no stored notification rows; mark_read = lastReadAt monotonic; admin unread aggregation
